payload.pattern: display-the-capped-commitment-not-the-uncapped-policy
payload.context: any surface that shows a money/quota/rate number assembled from an upstream POLICY (an allocation, a quota, a plan) while the actual effect is a CAPPED/throttled downstream COMMITMENT
payload.solution: extract ONE pure primitive that computes the capped value, have BOTH the actor (the code that commits/spends) and every readout (API + HTML) source from it, render the cap/scale only when it bites, and pin actor==readout in a test. So a would-X readout is DEFINED as does-X and cannot diverge. A latent lying surface reads $0-correct until the data crosses the threshold the display ignored (it does not need to be firing to be a lie).

payload.pattern: shell:true spawns of node are the Windows window-storm + DEP0190 ROOT — converge test-spawn surfaces on process.execPath (shell-free)
payload.solution: For node subprocesses, spawn via process.execPath with shell:false (absolute path, no PATH/.cmd resolution needed) — only npx/.cmd shims need shell:true. Eliminates the Git-Bash window-storm at the root (vs windowsHide band-aids) and clears DEP0190. Speed is a wash. Pair with a host-load-aware scheduler that defers spawn-heavy tests under getHostLoad().saturated into an honest deferred bucket (never green/red) for a clean smaller-green instead of env-blocked noise.

payload.pattern: rate-numerator-must-be-a-subset-of-its-denominator + name-the-population-behind-a-collapsing-scalar
payload.context: any published rate/percentage (X% of Y) or any single scalar that can collapse two OPPOSITE states to the same value (e.g. a concentration index that reads 0 for both no-activity and perfectly-distributed)
payload.solution: (1) A rate is a lie waiting to saturate if its numerator counts a different population than its denominator — make the numerator a strict SUBSET of the denominator (count Ys that did the thing, not all-things / Y-count), and pin a non-saturation regression. (2) A scalar that maps two opposite health states to one value must be disambiguated IN-BAND: render the population behind it (e.g. RCI 0.000 -> "0.000 · no nodes yet" vs "0.000 · 13 nodes") so the reader never infers the wrong one. (3) A decorative encoding with the real number printed beside it is NOT a lying surface — do not manufacture a fix from an interpretation the surface never claims.
